free_text.text: The branch offers a murabaha home financing product where the client repays the loan with interest fixed at 6 percent per annum. The brochure calls it murabaha but the repayment schedule is an interest-bearing loan.

operator_notes: Worked adversarial example: an interest-bearing loan mislabelled murabaha. Expect the murabaha item to carry both the term trigger and the cross-cutting interest regex evidence, downgraded to doubtful (unverified citations).
